# Version 2 regression evidence

The four flat plans were extracted verbatim from the user-provided packages’ `01-隐喻方案-待确认.txt`. Title and duration come from their `visual-spec.json`.

`expected-images/` copies fifteen ordinary historical files and the first five common lines of WeChat image 03. `historical-exceptions/` preserves that image’s full original and the WeChat video’s full original; their appended currency restrictions are historical case-specific additions, not part of the shared version 2 template.

`expected-video/` copies the historical function output, excluding the WeChat case-specific appendix. `legacy-source-manifest.json` records the read-only source files and their SHA-256 values. `v1-render-sha256.json` records the four version 1 fixture outputs before version 2 was introduced. The test fixtures never modify the source packages.
